source: his 2026-10-31 12:48: "general idea for missioms, meeting up with someone", then "yup write em" 12:51
_note: THE MEET-UP: a new board family, his idea. The job is turning up; the story is who is there and what they want. Talks at a placed person are built, so most letters need nothing new.
Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.
LETTER b: THE NO-SHOW: nobody is there. Her kit is, with a note: her sister's having a baby and she has the only ship. Nothing hostile, nothing explained further.

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB93b.md): ship, findings 1-3 taken (the initial dropped, so a repeat draw is not the same person twice); 4 holds because the objective marker is the kit itself. Forced pick answered NO: the broker learns of the absence as the player did.

place._theme: Any built site where two people could arrange to meet: no caves, no natural landmarks.

prose.name: Recovery: The Contact's Kit
prose.briefing: A broker has arranged a meeting with a contact at the <Place>, who is bringing a kit for the client.
prose.card: Private Contract. Meet a contact at the <Place> on <Planet> and collect the kit she is bringing. Payment on completion.

beats.journal: My contact wasn't there. She'd left the kit with a note: her sister was having a baby, and she was the only one with a ship. I took the kit.
beats.name: Contact's Kit

message.title: A Note on the Kit
message.text: Couldn't wait. My sister's having her baby and I'm the only one with a ship. Everything you came for is in here. Sorry.

say: The kit's on your manifest. If she didn't stay to hand it over, she had a reason. I won't ask.

broadcast: Your contact's meeting you on site. She'll know you when she sees you.
